skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply the principles of service-oriented architecture in software development.
Develop and implement web services using SOAP and RESTful protocols.
Design, analyze, and build service-oriented software systems.
Demonstrate the ability to learn independently and work in groups.
Work effectively in teams and individually, showing responsibility and ethical behavior.
Use Python for developing service-oriented software applications.
Understand and apply the system lifecycle in service-oriented software development.
Apply modeling techniques in service-oriented software development.
